items.exampleEn: The plants died because of a lack of water.
items.exampleZh: 這些植物因為缺水而死了。

items.exampleEn: TV has a lot of influence on children.
items.exampleZh: 電視對孩子有很大的影響。

items.exampleEn: You can always depend on your family.
items.exampleZh: 你永遠可以依靠你的家人。

items.exampleEn: Think about the consequences before you do something.
items.exampleZh: 做任何事之前，先想想後果。

items.exampleEn: This black and white photo has strong contrast.
items.exampleZh: 這張黑白照片的對比很強烈。

items.exampleEn: This city uses progressive ways to keep the streets clean.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市用先進的方法維持街道清潔。

items.exampleEn: Developed countries often have fast trains.
items.exampleZh: 已開發國家通常有快速的火車。

items.audioEn: We found a solution: we will share one car.
items.audioZh: 我們想到一個解決辦法：大家共用一輛車。
items.questionZh: 他們的解決辦法是什麼？

items.sentenceEn: A lack of sleep makes me tired.
There is a big contrast between the old town and the new town.
items.sentenceZh: 舊城區和新城區之間有很大的對比。

items.stemEn: If you don't do your homework, there will be ____.
items.stemZh: 如果你不寫作業，就會有後果。

items.stemEn: This school has ____ ideas about learning, like no tests.
items.stemZh: 這所學校對學習有先進的想法，例如不考試。

items.passageEn: This semester, our school tried a progressive idea: no homework on weekends. At first, some parents worried about the consequences, like a lack of practice. Others said the idea came from schools in developed countries. After three months, there was a clear contrast: students looked happier and slept more. The idea had a good influence on everyone. "Good results depend on happy students," said our headteacher.
items.passageZh: 這學期，我們學校試行了一個先進的做法：週末不出作業。一開始，有些家長擔心後果，例如練習不夠。也有人說這個做法來自已開發國家的學校。三個月後，對比很明顯：學生們看起來更快樂，也睡得更多。這個做法對大家都有好的影響。校長說：「好的成果取決於快樂的學生。」

questions.questionZh: 學校試行了什麼新做法？

items.promptZh: 我們需要一個解決辦法。
referenceEn: We need to find a solution.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 need a solution、find a solution

items.instructionZh: 用 influence 造一個句子，說說對你影響很大的一個人或一件事。
referenceEn: My father had a big influence on me.
This book had a great influence on my life.
rubricZh: influence 常寫 have an influence on…（例如 a big influence on me）
時態配合句意（例如 had、has）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：Our town is becoming more progressive. 的 progressive 多指觀念開明／政治上進步派，譯「越來越進步」易被理解為建設進步，與釋義「先進的」用法對不太上；且帶政治色彩，建議改用 progressive ideas 之類例句。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "This city uses progressive ways to keep the streets clean."（原 "Our town is becoming more progressive."）；一併第③關疑似 S14；新例句和閱讀（學校週末不出作業）主詞、情境、句型都不同

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "這座城市用先進的方法維持街道清潔。"（原 "我們的小鎮變得越來越進步。"）
